closure_requirements: Known-invalid realtime data-source choices are removed from normal Selection Center UI.
Factor/artifact source, selection entry price source, current quote source, and Paper execution source are clearly separated.
TDX is used only for quote/price enrichment paths required by BUG-113, not for factor computation.
Unsupported source requests fail before creating misleading failed selection runs.
description:
Expected: Selection Center separates selection score/artifact source, selection entry price source, current display quote source, and Paper v2 execution data source. Unsupported realtime sources such as TDX_REALTIME or MINIQMT_REALTIME must not be listed as runnable Selection Center data-source options. TDX is used through an explicit quote resolver for current-price display and current-date entry-price resolution, not as the factor/artifact data source.
Actual: The Selection UI exposes DB_HISTORICAL and TDX_REALTIME in a data-source dropdown. TDX_REALTIME is selectable even though the frontend warns it will fail and backend authoritative artifact generation rejects non-DB_HISTORICAL, causing a known-invalid operator path and conflating factor computation with quote display.

events.note: User clarified that selectable-but-guaranteed-failing TDX_REALTIME options have no value and must not be listed.
Created GitHub issue #184 and mirrored BUG-114 JSON.

Merged implementation evidence was re-audited on chore/paper-v2-issue-close-sync-audit-20260527; BUG JSON is marked fixed and GitHub issue should close when the audit PR merges. Audit record: tests/aistock_validation/history/paper_v2_selection_center/20260527_paper_v2_issue_close_sync_audit.md.

non_goals: Do not add TDX factor computation in this issue.
Do not change Paper v2 portfolio execution data-source configuration.
Do not change Selection rank/score behavior.
reproduce_command: Open /paper-v2/selection and inspect the data-source dropdown; TDX_REALTIME is presented as selectable even though authoritative Selection artifact generation rejects non-DB_HISTORICAL and the UI warns it will fail.
required_verification: TDX_REALTIME, MINIQMT_REALTIME, and any other unsupported realtime source are no longer shown as runnable Selection Center data-source options.
Selection UI displays a clear read-only source contract or uses an internal/renamed field with only supported selection artifact values.
Backend request validation rejects unsupported selection artifact sources before run creation or keeps the internal default hidden from operators.
TDX current quote is resolved through a separate quote/price resolver, not through the selection data_source field.
Existing DB_HISTORICAL authoritative artifact generation and historical PIT selection continue to work.
Historical run aggregation validates compatible source contracts without exposing a misleading realtime data-source selector.
Tests prove forged TDX_REALTIME cannot enter artifact generation as a guaranteed-failure run.
Validation record includes DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 and production gate reporting.
title: P1: Selection Center exposes invalid realtime data-source options that are not factor or quote sources
validation_evidence: Selection artifact data-source boundary is fixed by 07e66ac6; UI exposes DB_HISTORICAL only, backend rejects unsupported live artifact data sources, nox paper_v2_backend and GitHub main CI passed; Paper v2 issue closure audit PR #244 confirms BUG-114 is ready to close; production gates noop.
